answer: Duplicate or cloned identities leave a hollow signature that validators reject instantly, while honest agents who stake the minimum violet-tier bond pay only gas, not forfeiture. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity ledger: each agent locks a bond before voting, and peers challenge dubious registrations by demanding proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware relic embedded at enrollment. A successful forgery costs the full bond plus burned reputation, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
